Reviewer: Codex CLI 0.157.1, gpt-6-astra, medium effort. Head f34e826.

The change meets issue #102's merge-ready criteria: direct pins remain unchanged, all three vulnerable lockfile edges resolve to 4.18.1, and the report distinguishes source-based inference, observed parser behavior, and untested post-merge alert closure. Independently reproduced a frozen install in /tmp with pnpm 12.7.0, the single-version dependency graph, an unchanged lockfile after lockfile-only installation, and fixture exit codes 0/1/0; checked the recorded source commits and Dependabot failure excerpt, and confirmed green CI at this head. The checkout remains unchanged; full aggregate validation is supported by CI rather than a reviewer rerun, and there are no earlier review threads to resolve.

Findings: no blocking or non-blocking findings. The documented risk that fresh resolution can restore Chevrotain's exact vulnerable request remains explicit; post-merge alert closure belongs to the coordinator's follow-up recorded in #102.
